# Sunday Serif

> A soft serif for slow days. Free and open-source (SIL Open Font License 1.1), with print effects on variable axes. Made for Sunday (https://joinsunday.co). Roman and italic, a weight axis from 400 to 600 and three print effects as variable axes. Soft serifs, round terminals, a single-storey a.

- Weight axis `wght` 400 to 600, with named instances Regular (400), Medium (500) and SemiBold (600). Italic is a separate file per build.
- Effect axes: `BURN` Light Burn (-100 to 100, default 0: negative spreads the ink, positive thins the strokes to hairlines), `INKB` Ink Bleed (0 to 100), `WORN` Worn Print (0 to 100). At 0 the type is the clean print.
- Two web builds, each roman + italic variable WOFF2:
  - Text, family "Sunday Serif": SundaySerifText-Variable.woff2, SundaySerifText-Italic-Variable.woff2, about 45 KB each, `wght` only. Use it for text and preload it.
  - FX, family "Sunday Serif FX": SundaySerif-Variable.woff2, SundaySerif-Italic-Variable.woff2, about 1 MB each, all four axes. Load it only where effects show.
- Desktop formats: OTF and TTF statics (Regular, Italic, Medium, Medium Italic, SemiBold, SemiBold Italic) and variable TTF, for Figma, Keynote, Word, InDesign.
- Character set: Basic Latin, Latin-1 Supplement, Latin Extended-A (Western and Central European languages).
- Downloads: one zip per release (SundaySerif-X.Y.Z.zip) with SHA256SUMS.txt. Sources (designspace and UFO) are in the repository.
- npm: the `sunday-serif` package ships the web fonts, `text.css`, `fx.css` and `sunday-serif/next` for next/font.

## CSS

```css
@font-face { font-family: "Sunday Serif"; src: url("SundaySerifText-Variable.woff2") format("woff2"); font-weight: 400 600; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }
@font-face { font-family: "Sunday Serif"; src: url("SundaySerifText-Italic-Variable.woff2") format("woff2"); font-weight: 400 600; font-style: italic; font-display: swap; }
@font-face { font-family: "Sunday Serif FX"; src: url("SundaySerif-Variable.woff2") format("woff2"); font-weight: 400 600; font-display: swap; }
body { font-family: "Sunday Serif", Georgia, serif; }
.title { font-family: "Sunday Serif FX", "Sunday Serif", serif; font-weight: 600; font-variation-settings: "BURN" -15, "INKB" 20, "WORN" 15; }
```
